title: viburnum pubescens
intro: Viburnum pubescens, commonly known as Downy Arrowwood, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Viburnum pubescens include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Viburnum pubescens include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids, tannins, and volatile oils.
